entities.name: Hippogriff
entities.description: Flying creature resembling a griffin but with the body of a horse; seen on Innistrad and Mirrodin.

entities.name: Gryff
entities.description: Elegant heron-headed species of hippogriff of Innistrad, used by human knights as flying steeds.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi whose arrival twisted some gryffs.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Plane where hippogriffs have been seen.

events.summary: After Emrakul's arrival some gryffs become twisted by the Eldrazi's power.
events.quote: After Emrakul 's arrival, some became twisted by the Eldrazi 's power.

relations.note: a powerful force for her side
relations.quote: a powerful force for the side of Avacyn and her angels
